title: Domina, a lingua dolosa (Padovano)
desc: Annibale Padovano, Domina, a lingua dolosa, before 1583. 5 voices (Cantus, Quinta Vox, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0037); edited by Pyrros Bamichas, Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Michael Winter, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
